author: Queenk888
title: Mini game are useless
content:
I am at level 223 and came to realize that the mini games they have really don’t help if you are playing higher levels. It take more then 3 hours just to get 100 energy and they expect you to be able to finish their mini games in max 1-3 days. It takes me 2-3 days just to finish the harder orders. I don’t even participate in many of them because I know I’ll never win. Example the hamburger 🍔 mini game is near impossible to win with how long it takes for energy and to finish these harder orders. I am convinced I am going up against Ai because no way people are finishing orders that fast. Another example is the current cupcake mini game for the one year anniversary. Almost impossible to do and I’ve never been able to finish any other like it. When you finish orders you get a card pack and it is almost always a 1 star card pack. It literally doesn’t nothing because once you get all the one star cards you just start get repeats. Only harder orders get higher cards packs, but the only way to get the good card packs are to finish levels and that takes forever now that i have orders that take me days to complete.I know i can use the repeated card to buy packs but the i just get more repeat card from the one I bought. If i buy a card pack I should get guaranteed cards I don’t have yet. I never get to finish the card decks and now its is harder because of the golden card and now pink cards. I don’t even bother with it any more. And the ones that are fun and i can win are way to short like the digging for vegetables 🪏 and the supermarket 🛒 one only last a day.
But i get the most rewards for them, they should to be longer. Also the hand 👆that everyone complains about that tells you what to do, even with hints off is very annoying and I’ve seen so many people complain about it and nothing has changed. I was expecting more from this one year anniversary, more energy more prizes. We got a chest that gave the most basic items. It didn’t even help me finish an order. Very disappointing😕.I don’t like spending money on games, but as I continue this one it’s becoming more pay to win and it sucks because I really like it🥲

I wasn’t touching the board for that to happen.  It was not user error.  It is a game error they will not acknowledge.  

The game is fun when you first start playing.  Later stages get redundant, and take several days to complete recipes without paying to play.  Producers only produce 5-10 items before running out of energy.  One has to wait an hour to reset.  

The company’s response it problems with the game and the lack of fun in the later stages are the reason for the low rating.



Update:   Deleted the game.  Company is not worth dealing with.
